newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends weaker, near day's lows.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends weaker, near day's lows.

text.p: COMEX copper settled weaker after a lackluster, thinly traded session with little feature in a market heading for an early close this week.
Traders said they expected a further draw of about 3,000 tonnes in LME stocks Tuesday, with much of the offtake in Singapore because of deliveries to China.
Tuesday will be the last reporting period until next week, as COMEX and LME are closed Friday for Good Friday. LME is also closed next Monday.
LME tested upside resistance early in its session, but lacked follow-through and fell from the highs by the time COMEX opened.
COMEX May copper settled 1.10 cents weaker at 110.95 cents a pound, traded 111.90 to 110.85 cents. Spot March went out 0.85 cent weaker at 117.40 cents.
Volume was estimated at 7,500 lots compared to Friday's official 12,130 lots.
The LME cash to three months backwardation ended at $55/$59, off the day's high of about $60/$65.
